model_framework.screening_model: AquaPredict M5 Physical Hydrological Screening Model
model_framework.terrain_source: NOAA 2018 StratMap LiDAR Bare Earth DEM (1m)
model_framework.drainage_source: City of Houston Stormwater GIS (Inlets, Manholes, Gravity Mains, Outfalls)

scientific_disclaimers: EXPLORATORY SCREENING MODEL ONLY — NOT A CERTIFIED REAL-TIME FLOOD FORECASTING OR WARNING SYSTEM.
SYNTHETIC SURROGATE & MODELLED ESTIMATES: Not calibrated or validated against historical flood sensor observations.
Drainage capacity calculations assume clean, unobstructed conduits with free outfall into Buffalo Bayou.
Static mode displays precomputed scenario simulations and pre-extracted continuous heightmaps.

preset_10mm.snapshot_description: Static scenario snapshot at Minute 60 of 10mm rainfall event (uncalibrated M5 aggregate depression drawdown model; not dynamic time-dependent routing)
preset_10mm.recommendation_reason: Shortest Route is recommended: minimal travel distance under current scenario.
